description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 5310013912360 NUT,EYE: Line 0001 Qty 339 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0037 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract). All responsible sources may submit a quote which, if timely received, shall be considered. Quotes must be submitted electronically.
